title: Orthonormal-basis invariance of the full squared-tuple sum Σ_j α(b∘j)²
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let α be an n-covector on ℝ^P (α ∈ Covector (Euclid P) n, a continuous alternating n-linear form on ℝ^P = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P)), and let b = (b_0, …, b_{P−1}) and b' = (b'_0, …, b'_{P−1}) be orthonormal bases of ℝ^P indexed by Fin P. Then Σ_{j : Fin n → Fin P} α(b_{j(0)}, …, b_{j(n−1)})² = Σ_{j : Fin n → Fin P} α(b'_{j(0)}, …, b'_{j(n−1)})².
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n) (b b' : OrthonormalBasis (Fin P) ℝ (Euclid P)), ∑ j : Fin n → Fin P, (α (fun k => b (j k))) ^ 2 = ∑ j : Fin n → Fin P, (α (fun k => b' (j k))) ^ 2
